title: Explicit finite telescope cone blocks
statement: For a cochain sequence E with transitions t and telescope differential delta [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map], let S_k be the sum of E_0,...,E_k. Define d_k:S_k -> S_(k+1) as inclusion minus transition shift and C_k as its mapping cone. The finite-sum inclusions give maps C_k -> C_m for k<=m and C_k -> Cone(delta).

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Explicit finite telescope cone blocks.

proof.text: Define the finite sums as coproducts indexed by Fin(k+1). The finite differential is inclusion minus shift. Verify its square with each finite or infinite coproduct inclusion on injections, then apply mappingCone.map. Coproduct projections are left inverses to the inclusions. These formulas give strictly compatible block maps.
